race_courses.name: Poor Farm Park, 5 km
race_courses.start_note: Start and finish on a short connector trail in the woods, about 75 m before it meets the loop. Each lap is one ring of the park's mountain-bike singletrack, with no trail run twice; it crosses the gravel park road twice where OSM leaves the trail a few metres apart.

route_guide.getting_there: Park in the small lot the loop passes within 20 m of, on the park road. The start is in the woods, about 900 m back along the loop from that lot (each lap passes the lot about 900 m in), on a short connector trail off the loop. Check the course map before you set off.

race_courses.name: Poor Farm Park, 10 km (2 laps)
race_courses.start_note: Start and finish on a short connector trail in the woods, about 145 m before it meets the loop. Each lap is one ring of the park's mountain-bike singletrack, with no trail run twice; it crosses the gravel park road twice where OSM leaves the trail a few metres apart.

route_guide.getting_there: Park in the small lot the loop passes within 20 m of, on the park road. The start is in the woods, about 900 m back along the loop from that lot (each lap passes the lot about 900 m in), on a short connector trail off the loop. Check the course map before you set off.

race_courses.name: Poor Farm Park, half-marathon distance (3 laps)
race_courses.start_note: Start and finish on the short connector trail in the woods that the 5K and 10K use, close to where it leaves the lot side. Each 6.9 km lap is a longer ring of the park's mountain-bike singletrack through the west and south of the park, including the Muscle Loop and the Fence Trail, with almost no trail run twice; it crosses the gravel park road twice where OSM leaves the trail a few metres apart.

route_guide.getting_there: Park in the small lot on the park road that the 5K and 10K use. The start is on the short connector trail in the woods that those courses start on. Check the course map before you set off.
